summary: Verified the 3 new features end-to-end against the external Convex backend (fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site) and the Expo web preview. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass — new /auth/touch returns {ok:true}; /auth/sessions returns a list where exactly one item has current:true, every item has device_id/device/platform/last_seen_at, and NO raw session_token/token key is leaked; DELETE /auth/sessions/nonexistent-id is idempotent and leaves the current session intact (follow-up /auth/me still returns OWNER); /auth/me still returns OWNER for test_token_owner, DEVELOPER for test_token_dev, and 401 for missing/invalid tokens; OTP request still surfaces the Arabic WhatsApp/Bird error for +963984644375 and the 'أدخل رقم هاتف صحيح مع رمز الدولة' error for '123'. Frontend (mobile 390x844): injected session_token=test_token_owner, dismissed the guided tour, tapped testID account-button — trusted-devices-card renders inside account-sheet with title 'الأجهزة الموثوقة' and the current device shows the 'هذا الجهاز' badge. On the 'الإدارة' tab, tapped open-invite-button, filled invite-name-input with 'موظف اختبار', tapped create-invite-button — invite-qr image, invite-code-text ('EMP-0214-5AAF-D273', matches /^EMP-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$/) and copy-invite-code are all present. The activate screen (app/activate.tsx:49) renders testID scan-qr-button labelled 'مسح رمز QR بدل الكتابة' — verified in source as instructed (web preview has no camera, and the seeded tokens already have a role so the screen is not reachable in UI). No deprecated Expo packages or React Native issues found in the new code paths.
critical_code_review_comments: convex/sessions.ts list(): the sort callback returns a boolean (a.current ? -1 : b.current ? 1 : ...) — functionally works because of truthy/falsy coercion, but returning explicit -1/1/compare value is clearer and future-proof.

convex/sessions.ts revoke(): silently returns {ok:true} even if the device_id doesn't belong to the caller; this is intentional (idempotent + no enumeration), but worth a comment to prevent a future 'bug fix' that tightens it.

app/activate.tsx: QrScan locks on first scan via `locked` state but there is no visible feedback while the activate POST is in flight — a brief overlay or spinner on the camera view would prevent the user from pointing the phone away before the request resolves.
seed_data_creation: Created one real EMP invite (EMP-0214-5AAF-D273) under org_test_1 via the owner UI during the invite-QR test. It is just a pending-invite row and does NOT consume a user slot; safe to leave or clean up on next seed refresh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is EXTERNAL Convex at https://fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site/api — never hit the local FastAPI stub. OTP /auth/otp/request for Syria polls Bird for ~8–15s before returning 400; use timeout>=30s. Trusted-device state is per session_token: calling POST /auth/touch under test_token_owner stamps that one session row, and GET /auth/sessions returns exactly the rows for that user. The seeded test tokens all have a role, so the activate screen (app/activate.tsx) is NOT reachable in the UI with any of them — verify its scan-qr-button in source. Invite tests create a real pending invite row under org_test_1; it will accumulate if not cleaned, re-run `npx convex run edge:seedTestAccounts` to reset.
